headline: NVARC3 advances to sixth on ARC-3

sections.text: NVARC3 gained 2.94 points to reach 48.84, moving from 8th to 6th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move places NVARC3 inside the provisional gold places, which currently extend through 19th.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
